description: The property 'directory prefixes are unique within same layer' is flaky: its static MockRepo.get stub checks 'key in sorted_paths -> nil' before the created_dirs clause, so when the generator produces a parent alongside its child (e.g. [[f],[f,G]]), the just-created parent still reads as nonexistent during the child's parent check -> :parent_directory_does_not_exist -> flunk. Struck twice on stack CI (qzr19, qzr20) within 10 minutes. Fix: time-accurate stub that tracks repo.put(path) and answers get from the tracked set; add a deterministic parent-prefix regression test.
title: Flaky directory prefix-uniqueness property: static stub hides just-created parents
